question: Of the corn straw fuel and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel, which had the higher maximum weight loss rate at 30 °C/min, and what higher heating value does that fuel have?
rendered: According to Table 4, at 30 °C/min, the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) had a lower maximum weight loss rate of 19.71%/min compared to the corn straw fuel (SF) which had a maximum weight loss rate of 7.79%/min.
